name: smc-rb
notes: Follows Fig. 12 (smc-rb) with prune = with_tail_roulette(resample_{psi,eta}, kappa) (Fig. 13). Choices the paper leaves open: (1) The recursion over target prefixes is unrolled into a loop t = 1..|y| that passes (Q, R) from call t-1 to call t; identical semantics. (2) Weights are carried in log space (worst-case weights reach about e^-421); A is a log-sum-exp of every quotient and remainder term added in the call (beam-summing-z-hat). (3) Twist psi = is_live(., y_<=t) (twist-is-live); under it psi = 1 on every pool member, so resample's V w/(N W) is V/N and the ESS gate V^2 >= eta N sum W^2 is evaluated on raw weights with eta = setup.eta = 0.5. (4) Child sampling: one uniform u ~ rng.random() inverted through the cumulative of p(x'|x) psi(x x')/lambda over A,C,G,T in alphabet order; multinomial resampling uses N iid uniforms inverted through the normalized cumulative weights (searchsorted, right side). (5) Tail roulette (tail-roulette, kappa-dna): w0 is set to w for every particle entering call t (the quotient carried from call t-1, or the M copies of (eps,1/M) for t=1); children and resampled copies inherit w0; the coin flip is rng.random() < 0.5 per light particle, applied after resample in pool order; kappa = 0 (worst case) disables it. (6) Remainder: a member prefix adds w p(EOS|x) to R and A; when p(EOS|x) = 0 the entry is omitted (zero-mass-convention: zero contribution). Remainder re-check of R from call t-1 as in Fig. 12 lines 114-117. In this problem is_cylinder = is_member so R stays empty. (7) max_particles is the largest pool size after any resample+roulette step of the run (the initial M copies are not counted, but the first prune always keeps M). (8) Empty pool (empty-pool-handling, missing): if all particles die, later calls start from an empty quotient, A = 0 and log_z = -inf (failed-run-zero). (9) Randomness: one generator setup.rng(i, j, k) per run, consumed in the order child draws, resample draws, roulette draws per iteration. (10) Memoisation of next_probs and the three predicates across runs (cleared when the live cache passes 1e6 entries); it only saves time and does not change results. No closed forms, path sums or private source tables are used.
